brief: Google wins ad tech case avoiding breakup; jury deadlocked in Lindsay Clancy trial; Trump supports OpenAI in NYT lawsuit; papers explore new genetic and environmental research frontiers.
news_summary: Google avoids antitrust breakup as judge orders unspecified ad tech changes; Lindsay Clancy jury deadlocked again; Trump administration backs OpenAI against NYT; USPS builds mail-in ballot screening amid legal challenges.
papers_summary: Research highlights include a Parkinson's progression GWAS implicating TRIM2, and a study on DEM resolution impacts on flood applications; symbolic regression and waterlogging mitigation also feature.
